mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are experiencing clear skies and a comfortable 71 degrees over Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight, look up to spot a lovely waxing crescent moon, and don't miss the International Space Station crossing from the west-northwest to the southeast at exactly 11:08 PM.

In city news, Verona is continuing its sustainability initiatives. The city is actively upgrading streetlights and City Hall to LED bulbs to save energy, and is offering residential toilet and rain barrel rebate programs. Additionally, residents can help divert waste by dropping off food scraps at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop on East Verona Avenue.

There are several local events to look forward to this week. On Sunday, July 19th, you can check out the Mount Horeb Art Fair or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Next week also brings Hop Haus Trivia on Tuesday, July 21st, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday, July 22nd.

In the police report, officers responded to a collision on Wednesday, July 9th at County Highway PB and American Way, where a teenage driver failed to yield the right of way, resulting in minor injuries to a 74-year-old woman.

While the Verona Culver's is currently closed for the night, they will reopen tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM. Stop by tomorrow to try their delicious featured flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
